biography.value:
PLAYER CHARACTER — import as a Character actor, not an NPC.

Toadette is a Level 3 Circle of the Land (Forest) Druid for the table. Lore lives on the existing Waluipedia record captain_toadette. This JSON is only the Foundry PC sheet.

Status: Active — commanding Peach Loyalist forces.

Affiliation: Peach Loyalists.

Assign this actor to a player. Do not place it as a monster. XP: 1,730 / 2,700 (ledger key captain_toadette).

details.trait: Plans like a siege engineer. Total commitment.
details.flaw: No retreat. No prisoners. She will call that justice.

items.name: Druid — Circle of the Land (Forest), Level 3

description.value: Level 3 Druid. Circle of the Land — Forest. Spellcasting Wisdom. Hit die d8. A table translation of Toadette's siege-and-restoration command style.
Circle of the Land — Forest. Always-prepared: barkskin, spider climb, spike growth, pass without trace. Natural Recovery after a short rest.
Toad. Small. Walk 25 ft. The sports-and-party Toadette Waluigi remembers is not the one on this sheet. This one commands a crusade.
Background: military command of the Peach Loyalists. Fall of Bramblehaven — overnight sappers, three simultaneous breaches, a bastion taken in a day. Then the courtyard.
You know Druidic. You leave marks only another druid (or a very determined auditor) can read. Toadette uses it for sapper signs and no-retreat route marks.

Twice per short rest, bonus action, assume a beast form (CR 1/4, no fly/swim at this level unless the GM allows campaign beasts). Used here as fieldcraft and sapper cover, not as a joke mushroom mascot.

Land's Aid / Natural Recovery flavor: after a short rest, recover spell slots totaling half Druid level (rounded up). Circle spells (always prepared): barkskin, spider climb, spike growth, pass without trace — filed as siege tools (cover, walls, caltrops of thorn, silent approach).

Campaign feature — GM review. Toadette's written order: no prisoners from Fawful's forces. This is not a damage bonus. It is a political and moral fact on the sheet so the table cannot pretend it is not there. Using it has consequences. Peach would not have signed it.

Advantage on Intelligence (History) or Wisdom (Survival) checks to plan a breach, place sappers, or time three simultaneous attacks. Does not grant extra attacks. The masterpiece is in the plan, not in a feat tax.

Reference card only. Does not award XP. The bastion fell in a day. Fifteen surrendering troops were executed in the keep courtyard under standing orders. Some Loyalists hesitated. They were overruled.
Toadette's field staff. Simple melee, 1d6 bludgeoning, versatile 1d8. Cast shillelagh to make it a Wisdom weapon (1d8 magical bludgeoning) for one minute.
Backup blade. 1d4 piercing, finesse, light, thrown 20/60. Not a relic.
Field hide. AC 12 + Dex (max 2). What a commander wears in a sapper trench, not a parade.
+2 AC. Peach's crown painted on the boss. The paint is newer than the grief.
10 uses. Stabilize a creature without a Medicine check.
Five days. The crusade still eats.
Breach timing. Three notes, three teams.
Paper, not magic. The no-quarter clause is written in her hand. Waluigi has the moral objection; the table has the exhibit.
Ordinary Mushroom Kingdom field fungus. 2d4+2 HP if the table treats it as a potion of healing. One dose. Not a shop gag item.
Druidic + military. Routes, charges, and the line that must not be crossed backward.
Water. Even crusades need it.
For goodberry adjuncts and field dressings. Wisdom tool.
